subject: test_coord self-reference test fails on branches that lag remote decision ids
body: tools/test_coord.py test_decide_rejects_depending_on_itself computes the next id from local_decisions() only, while cmd_decide also counts remote branches via collect(). When a remote branch has a higher D-coord id the test fails and writes a real decision file. It is red on claude/project-thread-c4ldi5 (PR #23) and PR #26. Fix: known = set(coord.local_decisions()) | set(coord.collect(include_worktree=False)['decisions']); did = coord.next_decision_id('coord', known).
